repos.name: mikehasa/agentacct
repos.description: See what your coding agents did and what it cost. Breaks each task down into work steps — tools used, files changed, tests run, time and tokens spent. Local-first dashboard for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more. No login, no telemetry.
repos.one_liner: A local-first observability and cost-tracking dashboard for AI coding agents.
bullets: Built with Python, providing a local-first interface to monitor agent activity.
Tracks granular metrics including token consumption, latency, file modifications, and test execution results.
Enables financial oversight for engineering teams by breaking down costs per task and tool usage.
Integrates with popular agentic coding tools like Claude Code and Codex to provide transparency into automated workflows.
repos.img_alt: agentacct tui — live usage, cost, provider rate-limit bars, and recent sessions with per-session weekly-plan-cost estimates
repos.img2_alt: agentacct tui session detail — the per-step work ledger with pass/fail check evidence and a weekly-plan-cost estimate

repos.name: simonlin1212/vibe-astock
repos.description: A 股短线复盘看板：涨停池·连板梯队·龙虎榜·板块资金一屏看完，赚钱效应/晋级率/梯队断层/情绪周期等派生指标纯计算直出（不经过 AI），AI 只把数据串成能读的盘面研判。全本地运行，可用 Claude/Codex 订阅免 API key。| A-share short-term daily-review dashboard: derived sentiment metrics computed locally, AI only writes the narrative. No API key needed.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance local dashboard for A-share market sentiment analysis and short-term trading review.
bullets: Uses a hybrid approach: pure computational logic for market metrics and AI for narrative synthesis.
Calculates complex sentiment indicators like market breadth, ladder tiers, and capital flow without relying on external API calls.
Designed for local execution, ensuring data privacy and zero latency for high-frequency market monitoring.
Provides a comprehensive 'one-screen' view of market sentiment cycles and profit-making opportunities for quantitative traders.

repos.name: Flaminis/Dalaran
repos.description: Dalaran — Apache-2.0, robotics-first visualization and data infrastructure for multimodal time-series. ROS 2 native, reads existing .rrd recordings. A hard fork of Rerun.
repos.one_liner: A robotics-first visualization and data infrastructure for multimodal time-series analysis.
bullets: Built in Rust as a high-performance fork of Rerun, optimized for handling massive time-series datasets.
Native ROS 2 support allows for seamless integration with existing robotics and sensor data pipelines.
Designed to ingest and visualize .rrd recordings, making it ideal for auditing complex automated system behaviors.
Provides a robust infrastructure for developers to inspect multimodal data streams in real-time, critical for debugging autonomous agents.
